mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies and a temperature of 63 degrees at Badger Prairie County Park.

The City of Verona has updated us that the Fireman Park beach is now closed for the season. Additionally, please be aware that a portion of Highway M near the future Aldi site will be closed from October 6 through October 9 for road improvements, so please plan your travel accordingly.
It is a busy couple of days in town with Yoga at Insight Wellness happening today, followed by live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow.
In our weekly report, on September 21, a retail theft occurred at a business in the 400 block of East Verona Avenue involving a suspect who was later identified and cited.
You can enjoy the delicious Chocolate Heath Crunch flavor of the day at Culver's, which is currently open and serving guests until 10 PM tonight.
